title: Knapsack item selection with seeded tie-breaks and limits
notes: S1-E-PY. EvoEval-style mutation: d2 return the chosen indices (not the value) with a seeded tie-break between equal-value sets (fewest items, lowest weight or most items, then the lexicographically smallest index list); d3 + a max_items cap; d4 + item groups (at most one item per group). Difficulty guess for deepseek-flash: medium (d3).
